title: O.A./3227/2015 — ASHOK KUMAR v. M/O URBAN DEVELOPMENT
text:
CENTRAL ADMINISTRATIVE TRIBUNAL
PRINCIPAL BENCH
O.A. No. 3227/2015
New Delhi, this the 1st day of September, 2015.
HON’BLE MR. V. AJAY KUMAR, MEMBER (J)
Ashok Kumar
Assistant Accounts Officer
Aged about 46 years
S/o Sh. Zorawar Singh
R/o 885, Sec-12, Sonepat
Haryana. … Applicant
(By Advocate : Shri M.K. Bhardwaj)
Versus
UOI & Ors. through
1. The Secretary
Department of Expenditure
Ministry of Finance
North Block, New Delhi.
2. The Controller General of Accounts
Ministry of Finance
Department of Expenditure
Lok Nayak Bhawan
New Delhi. …. Respondents
(By Advocate : Shri Hanu Bhaskar)
ORDER (ORAL)
Heard Shri M.K. Bhardwaj for the applicant and Shri
Hanu Bhaskar, who appeared on behalf of the respondents.

OA 3227/2015
2
2. The applicant filed the present O.A. aggrieved by the
Office Memorandum dated 11.08.2015 (Annexure A-1),
whereunder the applicant was transferred from Ministry of
Urban Development, Karnal to Ministry of Home Affairs, Dadra
and Nagar Haveli.
3. It is submitted that the applicant was transferred on a
number of occasions during the last four years. Vide order
dated 05.06.2009 (Annexure A-3), he was transferred from
Ministry of Urban Development to Ministry of Commerce, vide
order dated 13.10.2011 (Annexure A-4) transferred from
Ministry of Commerce and Textiles, New Delhi to Ministry of
Urban Development, Karnal, vide order dated 16.05.2014
(Annexure A-5) from Ministry of Urban Development to CBDT,
Karnal, vide order dated 31.12.2014 (Annexure A-6)
transferred from CBDT, Karnal to Ministry of Information &
Broadcasting, Delhi and again vide order dated 23.03.2015
(Annexure A-8) from Prasar Bharti, New Delhi to Ministry of
Urban Development, Karnal. Thereafter vide the present
impugned order, from Karnal to Dadra and Nagar Haveli.
4. The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the
impugned transfer order is in violation of the Transfer Policy
issued vide Office Memorandum dated 14.05.2008 (Annexure
A-10), inasmuch as without completion of the tenure period of

OA 3227/2015
3
four years, the applicant was transferred on a number of
occasions from one place to another and further the
applicant’s wife is working in Delhi on a non-transferable post.
In the circumstance, the applicant made representation dated
14.08.2015 (Annexure A-9) ventilating his grievances to the
respondents seeking retention of his service in the present
place of posting at Karnal. However, the respondents have not
passed any orders thereon till date.
5. In the circumstances, the O.A. is disposed of at the
admission stage, without going into the merits of the case, by
directing the respondents to consider the representation dated
14.08.2015 of the applicant, duly considering all the grounds
taken by the applicant in his representation and to pass
appropriate speaking and reasoned orders thereon, in
accordance with law, within two weeks from the date of receipt
of a copy of this order. Till then, the applicant shall be
continued at the present place of posting. No order as to costs.
(V. AJAY KUMAR)
Member (J)
/Jyoti/
